name: ink-wash-poster
title_zh: 把任意素材变成一张水墨风海报与配图
tagline_zh: 诗句、照片、活动、情绪……丢进来，还你一张留白得当、纸纹可见的水墨海报。构图和排版都替你拿捏，不用会设计。
tagline_en: Feed it a poem, photo, mood, or event—get back a quiet ink-wash poster with real paper grain and restraint. No.
desc_en: Generate an ink-wash editorial poster prompt and the matching bitmap image from a user's theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, content brief, poem, memory, event, place, or other creative material. Use when the user wants a quiet, spacious, tactile ink-wash poster, cover, cultural visual, or reference-photo reinterpretation with thoughtful composition, paper texture, restrained typog
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳：它先解析素材里的意象与结构，再重排构图和文字层级，让水墨感长在内容上，而不是糊在表面。
why_en: Not a filter: it parses the source's imagery and structure, then rebuilds composition and typographic hierarchy so the ink-wash.
limit_zh: 只出单张竖版海报图（含对应提示词），不生成系列、不排版多页。需要你本机装好图像生成环境；若素材是照片，只做风格化重绘。
limit_en: Outputs one vertical poster image + its prompt only—no series, no multi-page layout. Requires a local image-gen setup; photos get stylized redraws.
